name: Camping Seespitz Walchsee
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Seespitz Walchsee is located directly on the shores of Lake Walchsee in the Kufstein district. The resort features generous pitches for caravans and motorhomes alongside a private lakeside beach with sunbathing lawns and a jetty. Guests also enjoy access to a heated outdoor swimming pool. Sailing and windsurfing are popular on the lake, making the site a favourite for families and outdoor enthusiasts.
